title: Automated External Defibrillator (AED) Monthly Maintenance
agency: VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.STRATEGIC ACQUISITION CENTER FREDERICKSBURG (36C10G)
description_text: The VA is seeking potential vendors who have the ability to provide monthly site visit services for maintenance of Automated External Defrillator devices at VA Office of Information Technology (OIT) facilities throughout the contiguous United States.
